sources.label: NAUR LesBin - UltiProject: full FRU Phase 5 guide
NAUR LesBin - P5 Exawaves center-dodge guides

steps.title: Stack in the diamond
steps.cue: the first Path of Light and Path of Darkness casts start
steps.rule: The six seams leave one small diamond open, about 7m from the centre on a cardinal, boxed in by the three spots where a cardinal seam crosses a diagonal one. The whole party stacks inside it.

steps.title: Step away from the first seams
steps.cue: the second Path of Light and Path of Darkness casts start
steps.rule: Shuffle a step across the diamond, away from the first pair of seams, before they explode and start rolling outwards.

steps.title: Weave behind each wave
steps.rule: Every 2s each strip rolls 5m further. Right after each explosion, step into the ground it just left, staying inside the diamond, until the last wave has passed.

steps.title: Light parties for Akh Morn
steps.rule: Split into the two light parties an eighth of a turn either side of the diamond, 7m from the centre: MT, H1, M1 and R1 on the clockwise side, OT, H2, M2 and R2 on the counter-clockwise side. Each side takes one stack.
